The ticker cannot yield the forty requested rows; obtaining forty is structurally ensured by the comprehension when it returns, so this is a population sanity assertion and not the regression guard.
Review event subject resolution is removed or points at another run/node; expected IDs are derived from fixture identities independently of the event output.
The stop skips a reviewer, targets another pid/start identity, repeats a stop, or changes the expected order; the Mock observes the calls actually issued.
The stop no longer persists phase=stopped, despite signalling; runs.read_pointer reads the written result.

The persisted stop receipt is missing or names a record other than the declaration; comparison to fixture input is legitimate round-trip evidence, not the one-list regression guard, and cannot pass if the write is removed.

Remove forwarding from any delivery-chain hop or baseline-event subject resolution: original code makes eleven reads, and restoring either nested path exceeds the independent literal one; negative-control.log records the original failure.
